the trail of shells that leads Dory home

Cheddar cracker dough of cheese, butter and flour rolled thin, cut into shell shapes and baked at 180C for 12 minutes until golden. Rub 100g cold diced butter into 150g plain flour with a pinch of salt and half a teaspoon of smoked paprika. Stir in 150g finely grated vintage cheddar and bring together with 2 tbsp cold water. Chill 20 minutes, then roll out 3mm thick between baking paper. Cut into shell shapes with a small cutter and press lines in with a fork. Bake on a lined tray at 180C for 12 minutes until golden. Cool before serving with a chive sour cream dip.

the ocean Hank won't go back to

Orecchiette tossed with basil pesto, sweet peas, baby spinach and lemon, finished with parmesan and toasted nori crumbs for a taste of the sea. Cook 400g orecchiette in salted water, adding 2 cups frozen peas for the last 2 minutes. Toast 2 nori sheets over a flame until crisp and crumble them. Drain the pasta, keeping a cup of the water. Toss the pasta and peas with 190g basil pesto, 2 handfuls baby spinach, the zest and juice of half a lemon and 50g grated parmesan, adding pasta water until glossy. Serve topped with the nori crumbs and more parmesan.

s.note: Crisp sesame nori, for a kelp forest that all looks the same
s.how: Brush 6 nori sheets lightly with sesame oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds and a pinch of salt. Toast one at a time in a dry pan for 30 seconds a side until crisp. Cut into strips with scissors and pile into a bowl like a kelp forest.

s.note: Watermelon, kiwi, berries and grapes in colour blocks, so Hank blends in
s.how: Arrange 2 cups watermelon cubes, 1 punnet hulled strawberries, 2 sliced kiwi fruit, 1 punnet blueberries and 500g green grapes in colour blocks on a big platter so the fruit 'hides' in patches. Serve with 200g vanilla yoghurt in a bowl for dipping.

m.note: Lime chilli chicken over rice with avocado, corn and black beans
m.how: Marinate 800g chicken thighs in lime juice, chilli and salt, then grill and slice. Build bowls of long grain rice with the chicken, sliced avocado, corn, black beans and a spoon of salsa. A California beach lunch in a bowl.

w.note: Blue jelly, whipped cream, orange slice. Just keep swimming.
w.how: Make up 2 packets of blue jelly and pour into glasses. Chill for 3 hours until set. Top with whipped cream and tuck a slice of orange on top of each for a little orange fish. Just keep eating.

d.note: Blue lemonade with a scoop of vanilla ice cream floating on top
d.how: Pour cold lemonade into tall glasses and add a drop of blue colouring, stirring until ocean blue. Gently add a scoop of vanilla ice cream so it floats and foams. Serve straight away with a long spoon.
